metadata.chapter_subtitle: Damaging straight-line winds from thunderstorm outflows

inventory.summary: The downburst and derecho chapter had a clear technical core, but it needed onboarding so the scale difference between local downbursts and regional derechos was framed before the formal model.
issues: The chapter lacked a learner-facing setup block.
The contrast between downbursts and derechos benefited from earlier conceptual framing.
The hazards sequence needed consistent entry structure.

rewrite.summary: Added stronger onboarding and preserved the downdraft, outflow, and derecho dynamics treatment.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the opening to foreground the cold-outflow sequence.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now enters at a fairer pace and keeps the distinction between local and mesoscale wind hazards conceptually clear.

repair.summary: The main repair was pedagogical: clearer framing around outflow physics and scale.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the cold-outflow sequence before the formal equations.

design_review.summary: The chapter's explanatory support remains effective, and the stronger opening improves interpretation of the hazard structure.
